::: {#exr-toe-lose-pen}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: C07-gwbhx
f <- doodle_fun(~ x + y, seed = 783)
Pts <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ x, ~ y, ~ label,
  -3.5, 3.5, "A",
  2.5, 0, "B",
  -1, -2.5, "C",
  0, -2, "D"
)

dfdu <- D(f(x, y) ~ x)
dfdw <- D(f(x, y) ~ y)
vectorfield_plot(u ~ dfdu(u, w), w ~ dfdw(u, w), 
                 npts = 20,  domain(u = -4:4, w = -4:4)) |>
  gf_text(y ~ x, label = ~ label, data = Pts, color = "blue", 
          size = 6, inherit = FALSE) |>
  gf_point(2.6 ~ -2.2, shape = 16, inherit=FALSE) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed()) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())
  
```

The graph shows gradient vectors of a function. Starting at the black dot, follow the vectors until you reach the end of the trail. Which of the letters is closest to trail's end?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c("A", "B", "C", "D"), correct = "D", id = "tlp-1-oiw", sort = TRUE)`


:::
